title: SAGE: Surrogate-gradient Adaptation via Attention-Guided Entropy for Spiking Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2608.13702v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient alternative to conventional deep neural networks by exploiting sparse event-driven computation, but their training remains challenging because the non-differentiable spike function requires surrogate gradients whose fixed shape may be suboptimal across layers and training stages. In this work, we introduce SAGE, an uncertainty-modulated surrogate-gradient mechanism for Transformer-based SNNs. SAGE estimates block-level uncertainty from normalized self-attention entropy and uses this signal to adapt the surrogate-gradient slope during training while leaving the inference model unchanged. By modulating only the training-time surrogate parameter, the proposed method preserves the original architecture and deployment cost while improving optimization flexibility. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100 demonstrate that SAGE achieves improved accuracy over fixed-surrogate baselines, with results

translated_title: SAGE：基于注意力引导熵的替代梯度自适应方法用于脉冲Transformer
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络（SNNs）通过利用稀疏事件驱动计算，为传统深度神经网络提供了一种能效替代方案，但其训练仍然具有挑战性，因为不可微的脉冲函数需要替代梯度，而替代梯度的固定形状在不同层和训练阶段可能不是最优的。在这项工作中，我们引入了SAGE，一种针对基于Transformer的SNN的不确定性调制替代梯度机制。SAGE从归一化的自注意力熵中估计块级不确定性，并利用该信号在训练期间调整替代梯度斜率，同时保持推理模型不变。通过仅调制训练期间的替代参数，所提出的方法保留了原始架构和部署成本，同时提高了优化灵活性。在CIFAR-10/100上的实验表明，SAGE相比固定替代基线实现了更高的准确率，结果...
tldr: SAGE通过基于自注意力熵的不确定性调制替代梯度斜率，在不改变推理架构的情况下提升了脉冲Transformer的训练效果和准确率。
en_tdlr: SAGE improves training accuracy of spiking Transformers by adaptively modulating surrogate-gradient slopes based on self-attention entropy uncertainty, without altering the inference architecture.
